notes.title: Release delayed due to technical errors
notes.content:
We have a few errors where we are scratching our heads on what happened. 
Here's what we have been trying to get done:

1. Get the mac version running because the original package that was supposed to be for pc/mac/linux turns out only works on PC after review.
2. Get app shortcut to work from steam client, it's not displaying correctly.

Once we get over this hurdle PM should be ready to see the world audience. 

Our apologies for the delay.
